title: MCP spec now requires 12 months between deprecation and removal
detail: The 2026-07-28 revision of the Model Context Protocol specification introduced a formal deprecation policy mandating a minimum twelve-month window between a feature being deprecated and its earliest possible removal.
impact: The first enforceable stability guarantee anywhere in this stack. No model API currently offers a window this long, so anything you build against MCP carries less migration risk than the same thing built against a vendor SDK.
